reviews.reviewer: gemini-3.5-flash-lite full film technical and editorial quality check

checks.evidence: The opening scene clearly establishes the dogs, their relationships, and the premise of breakfast waiting and questioning past whereabouts.
Cuts between hallway, rooms, and multi-dog shots maintain spatial geography and clear motivation.
Dog appearances, collars, and room settings remain consistent across cuts throughout the video.
Dialogue matches the visible talking dog on screen with consistent voices and gender matching throughout.
Dialogue delivery is natural with appropriate pauses and clear timing between conversational turns.
Dog movements and facial articulations are consistent with the established photoreal talking animal style without anatomical distortions.
Audio is clear, dialogue is audible, and voice consistency is maintained with no abrupt audio clipping.
Relationships are established quickly through dialogue.
The grandmother follows a scent to the grooming room.
Bruno and Sadie respond to the grandmother calling.
Sebastian is established as dead before the scent is found.
Plots move at a moderate pace without excessive filler.
